zh: 圣保罗大学（Universidade de São Paulo，简称 USP）成立于1934年，是巴西最大、最负盛名的公立研究型大学，也是拉丁美洲最重要的学术机构之一。学校主校区位于圣保罗市，在巴西多个城市设有校区，以其在医学、生物学、物理学、数学、工程学、人文科学和社会科学等广泛领域的卓越研究而著称。
en: University of São Paulo (USP) was founded in 1934 and is Brazil's largest and most prestigious public research university and one of Latin America's most important academic institutions. With its main campus in São Paulo and campuses in several Brazilian cities

contact: the university is renowned for its卓越 research in medicine
